content:
Use FlovaAI’s AI Short Drama One-Stop Generation workflow to take a Seedance 2.5 project from story concept through visual development, scene creation, sound, and final assembly.  
Set a clear production format up front (e.g., 60-second film, painterly Victorian dark-romance style) to keep Seedance 2.5 generations consistent.  
Create consistent character and environment artwork first, then use that approved artwork as references when generating Seedance 2.5 scenes to maintain visual continuity.  
Break the story into a fixed number of cinematic scenes (e.g., four scenes) and generate each as a separate Seedance 2.5 clip (e.g., four 15-second videos) to assemble into the final runtime.  
Create shot-planning visuals to pre-map camera movement, framing, and emotional pacing before generating the Seedance 2.5 clips.  
Add ~0.3-second fades between scenes in the final edit to make transitions smoother.  
Iterate the edit by testing narration/monologue, then remove it if it weakens the pacing or mood.
